subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103604 lands, should the source-only `qa-matrix` package and private QA Lab facade be removed on this head?
rationale: The code path is coherent and proven, but deleting a workspace package, plugin identity, facade exports, and lockfile importer is an intentional compatibility and dependency-authorization decision that automation cannot approve.

options.title: Approve ordered removal
options.body: Land the predecessor, verify direct `qa-matrix` consumers are absent, authorize the exact dependency deletion, and merge this PR.

options.title: Retain a temporary shim
options.body: Keep a deprecated compatibility registration for one more cycle if maintainers know of source-checkout consumers that still address the old plugin ID or facade.

recommendation.title: Approve ordered removal
recommendation.body: Land the predecessor, verify direct `qa-matrix` consumers are absent, authorize the exact dependency deletion, and merge this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent package, updater, and private-QA sidecar history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the compatibility and dependency-removal decision.
